name: h16_us_macro_surprise_v1

normalization.rule: surprise_std(t) = signed(actual-consensus) / sample_std(prior signed surprises from the same event family); current/future releases are excluded

final_oos.instruction: Do not inspect H16 returns or tune thresholds using this period before the preregistered OOS run.

source_policy.actuals: Archived official BLS and BEA release pages only.
source_policy.consensus: Must come from a separately recorded pre-release consensus source. Official actuals collector intentionally leaves consensus blank.
source_policy.revisions: Do not replace as-released headline values with later revised time-series values.

research_rule: No strategy thresholds or XAUUSD direction mapping may be inferred from OOS. Macro surprise sign is descriptive only; gold direction is tested separately.
